hypothesis: Fine-tuning the on-device model into a LoRA adapter should outperform any in-context prompt baseline, because the task-specific question style is baked into the weights rather than re-instructed each call.
technique: A single greedy on-device call using a v1 LoRA adapter (epoch 1 checkpoint), no sampling — serving as the full-30 gate baseline for the adapter series.
result: Scored 0.362 on the full-30 gate (1 win / 3 ties / 25 losses vs Sonnet); rubric showed atomicity at 4 but specificity, coverage, naturalness, and non-redundancy all at 3. Kept as the new best — establishing the adapter series baseline to beat.
label: adapter_e1_g
